embeds.title: 📚 Gleecin Academy Homework: Mommy & Baby HUD
embeds.description: A friendly instructor summary of the assignment. The attached document contains the full homework details and checklist.

fields.name: Assignment Goal
fields.value: Debug the HUD, connect it to Supabase, deploy the backend on Render, and ensure persistent baby/profile data across resets, crashes, redelivery, and relogs.

fields.name: Core Tasks
fields.value:
1. Debug HUD button/prim mapping and touch events
2. Set up Supabase schema, migrations, and policies
3. Verify Render deployment with no build/log errors
4. Persist baby stats and settings in Supabase
5. Create .env.example and configure Render env vars
6. Run curl/integration tests for API create/update/read
7. Confirm persistence through resets, restarts, and redelivery
8. Test in-world and document bugs with expected behavior

fields.name: Deliverables
fields.value: Complete the Homework Checklist, verify backend and Supabase functionality, and confirm in-world testing results.
